overview: At nine you left the plot as it was. The note stays the note, and you did not write a new height for Nick. You did not make a new entrance.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Checked the plot and added nothing.

parties.name: Nick Sorrell
parties.context: Named on the plot, and not given a higher note.

summary: Read the plot and put Nick's note back on the peg
